APPROVE
The extraction keeps `Js` well under 15 and preserves the original logic: the inverted config-exclusion condition is correct, and the only reordering is evaluating the pure `Runs(s)` eagerly. I couldn't build or test, though, because the environment returned no tool output, so the build claim rests on the assumption that the new parameter types `JsInventory.Inventory` and `JsInventory.Package` exist under those exact names.
